title: Panic Inbox
intro: Ten frightening messages, one minute. Panic is the scammer's favourite tool.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Your login code is 731204. Never share it with anyone, including Ostrel staff.
cards.why: A code you asked for, with a warning not to share it.

cards.text: Your wallet is flagged. Pay a fine of 0.05 BTC at wallet-fines.help within 24 hours.
cards.why: A fine in crypto, through a link, with a deadline.

cards.text: Pay your crypto tax penalty in USDT now: civic-pay-usdt.com
cards.why: Tax offices never take a penalty in USDT through an email link.

cards.text: You enabled a new withdrawal address. If this was not you, open the app and lock your account.
cards.why: It tells you what you did, and sends you to your own app.

cards.text: Stay on camera. Move your coins to the court wallet or a warrant is issued today.
cards.why: No court asks for coins. Staying on camera is the isolation trick.

cards.text: Your SIM will be blocked tonight. Reply YES and send the code we text you.
cards.why: A threat, a reply and a request for a code. All warning signs.

cards.text: A payment of £40 to a new payee was paused. Review it in the Orrin app.
cards.why: It names something you can check, and points to the app.

cards.text: Hi Dad, my phone broke. Please send 300 USDT to this address, I will explain later.
cards.why: A "family" message with a crypto request from a new number.

cards.text: Your monthly statement is ready in the app. No action needed.
cards.why: It asks for nothing and points to the app.

cards.text: Your account was hacked. Move your coins to our safe wallet now.
cards.why: A "safe wallet" belongs to the caller. Hang up and open the app.

golden_rule: When a message scares you, slow down. Real alerts point you to your own app. Scams point you to a link, a number or a wallet.

quick_check.q: A caller says your account was hacked and tells you to move your coins to their safe wallet. What do you do?

options.text: Hang up, open the app yourself, and report the call

quick_check.explain: A "safe wallet" from a stranger is their wallet. Hang up and check in your own app.
